activities.title: Who Waters the Garden?
activities.skill: Listening for who does an action
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Then tap the picture that answers the question.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Luego toca el dibujo que responde la pregunta.
activities.script: It is a sunny day at the community garden. Grandpa Luis digs with a shovel. His granddaughter Ana has a watering can. Ana waters the bean plants.
vocabulary: a place where people grow plants
huerto: lugar donde se cultivan plantas
to give a plant a drink
regar: darle agua a una planta
activities.correct: Ana has the watering can, and she waters the beans.

activities.title: Shopping at the Market
activities.skill: Listening for more than one item
activities.directions: Listen to Mom's list. Tap every food she wants. There is more than one.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha la lista de mamá. Toca cada comida que quiere. Hay más de una.
activities.prompt: Which foods does Mom want? Choose all that fit.
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué comidas quiere mamá? Elige todas las que sirven.
activities.script: We are going to the market. Mom says, we need three things: bananas, eggs, and bread. We do not need apples today. We have apples at home.
vocabulary: words written one under another to remember things
lista: palabras escritas para recordar cosas
activities.correct: Mom wants bananas, eggs and bread. They already have apples.

activities.title: How Ana's Beans Grew
activities.skill: Listening for the order of events
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Tap the pictures in order: first, next, last.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Toca los dibujos en orden: primero, después, al final.
activities.prompt: What happened first, next and last?
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué pasó primero, después y al final?
activities.script: First, Ana put bean seeds in the dirt. Next, she watered them every day. After one week, little green sprouts came up. At the end of summer, the plants had flowers and beans.
vocabulary: a small part that a new plant grows from
semilla: parte pequeña de la que crece una planta
brote: una planta nueva y pequeña
activities.correct: Plant, water, sprout, then flowers. That is how a bean plant grows.
activities.hint: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.support: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.extension: Tell a grown-up one more thing that happened in the story.

activities.skill: Listening for things to do and not do
activities.directions: Listen to Ms. Rivera. Tap every thing she asks you to do.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha a la maestra Rivera. Toca cada cosa que te pide hacer.
activities.prompt: What does Ms. Rivera ask you to do? Choose all that fit.
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué te pide hacer la maestra Rivera? Elige todas las que sirven.
activities.script: Welcome to the library, class. Please use quiet voices. Choose one book from the shelf. Do not run. When you finish, put your chair back.
vocabulary: a flat board that holds things
estante: tabla donde se ponen cosas
to take something and give it back later
tomar prestado: usar algo y devolverlo después
activities.correct: Quiet voices, one book, and chairs back. Running is the one thing she says not to do.

activities.title: Why Did the Plant Droop?
activities.directions: Listen to the whole story. Then tap the answer that tells why.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha todo el cuento. Luego toca la respuesta que dice por qué.
activities.script: Omar planted a tomato plant in a pot. He put the pot by the sunny window. For four days, Omar forgot to water it. The soil got very dry. On Friday the leaves were droopy and soft. Omar gave the plant a drink, and the next day it stood up tall again.

options.text: The plant had too much sun and no shade.
The plant did not get water for days.

vocabulary: caído: que cuelga y está débil
tierra: suelo donde crecen las plantas
porque: palabra que dice por qué
activities.correct: Omar forgot to water it, the soil got dry, and water fixed it. That is the cause.

activities.support: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.

activities.title: The Lost Mitten
activities.skill: Listening to infer where something is
activities.directions: Listen to the clues. Tap where the mitten is.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha las pistas. Toca dónde está el guante.
activities.prompt: Where is Nadia's mitten most likely?
activities.promptEs: ¿Dónde está probablemente el guante de Nadia?
activities.script: Nadia played outside in the snow. She made a snowman by the big tree. Then she went inside for hot cocoa. Oh no, one red mitten was gone! Nadia thought about where she took it off. She took it off to give the snowman a carrot nose.

options.text: by the snowman and the tree

vocabulary: a warm cover for your hand
guante: prenda para abrigar la mano
probable: que tal vez es cierto
activities.correct: She took the mitten off to put the carrot nose on the snowman by the tree.

activities.title: Too Many Tomatoes
activities.skill: Listening for a problem and a solution
activities.directions: Listen. Tap the picture that shows how the problem was solved.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha. Toca el dibujo que muestra cómo se resolvió el problema.
activities.prompt: How did Ana solve the problem?
activities.script: The garden had so many ripe tomatoes. Grandpa Luis said, we cannot eat all of these. They will go bad. Ana had an idea. She put the tomatoes on a table by the gate with a sign: Free for neighbors. By lunchtime, every tomato was gone.

options.text: She shared the tomatoes with neighbors.

vocabulary: maduro: listo para cosechar y comer
a person who lives near you
vecino: persona que vive cerca de ti
to give some of what you have to others
compartir: dar a otros parte de lo que tienes
frames: The problem was ___. Ana solved it by ___.
activities.correct: Ana shared the extra tomatoes with neighbors so they would not go bad.

activities.title: What Should Mia Wear?
activities.skill: Listening to apply information to a choice
activities.directions: Listen to the weather report. Tap what Mia should wear.

activities.script: Good morning! Here is today's weather. It will be cold this morning, only forty degrees. In the afternoon, rain will come. Bring something to keep you warm and dry.
